cadence.evidence: The tree is git-managed; its two JSON outputs carry db_built_at 2026-08-07T02:20:12Z. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X measured (73215 Q2) that the GENERATORS ran in production at 02:00Z on the carding day -- so the CODE is exercised on a schedule while the OUTPUTS in this tree are 19 days old. Those are two different clocks for one directory, which is precisely why the directory is a poor unit of cadence and its two output files are separate subjects.

persistence.evidence: MEASURED SPLIT: of 12 entries, 9 are git-TRACKED and 3 are UNTRACKED (c2_instances.json, c3_structures.json, __pycache__). So THE CODE IS VERSIONED AND THE OUTPUTS ARE NOT -- and the outputs are 12.4MB that the derive ingests.

location.evidence: Directory listed directly at HEAD. ⛔ GRAIN OVERLAP, STATED SO IT IS NOT READ AS TRIPLE-COUNTING: this subject is the DIRECTORY, and two of its members (c2_instances.json, c3_structures.json) are ALSO separate wave-2 subjects in this same lane. Their coverage is a strict subset of this card's. Three cards, one tree, by the frozen subject set's own construction.

The meaningful coverage figures live in the two output subjects' own counts blocks and are reported there, not double-counted here.

The presence of 4 in-tree tests including test_producer_reader_executed.py suggests the failure surface IS tested by its owner, but I did not run them and will not claim their result.

silent_degrade_paths: the outputs are untracked, so a deleted or truncated output is unrecoverable from git and would surface only as a downstream derive failure

verdict.why: Carded at the DIRECTORY grain because the frozen subject set names the directory, and that grain is the card's own limitation: a file count is not a coverage measure, the code and the outputs run on two different clocks, and the meaningful trust questions belong to the two output subjects carded separately. INCOMPLETE rather than QUALIFIED because the failure-mode row is unexercised by choice -- this is CVO's tree and running its composer is not my act. The tree's genuine strength, which no other subject this lane carded has, is that it ships its own test suite.
